context: A teacher pays a home visit; mother and daughter prepare
purpose: Teach: トイレ/ガラス/メートル/文庫/余り/いらっしゃる/ハウス/ライフ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: さくら、もうすぐ先生がいらっしゃるから、トイレのガラスの窓も拭いておいて。
lines.en: Sakura, the teacher will be here soon, so wipe down the glass window in the bathroom too.
lines.style: Hurried maternal instruction with a slight edge of pre-guest anxiety

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えー、トイレまで?余りに細かすぎない?もう三十分も掃除してるんだけど。
lines.en: Whaaat, even the bathroom? Isn't that excessively picky? I've been cleaning for thirty minutes already.
lines.style: Teenage exasperation drawn out with mild whining complaint

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うちは普通のハウスメーカーの家だけど、ライフスタイルがちゃんとしてるって思われたいの。
lines.en: Our home is just a standard builder house, but I want her to think we have a proper lifestyle.
lines.style: Confiding tone mixing pride and middle-class insecurity

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そんなの先生、玄関から二メートルも入らないうちに分かるって。気にしすぎだよ。
lines.en: The teacher will figure that out before she's two meters past the entrance. You're overthinking it.
lines.style: Dismissive teen logic delivered with affectionate eye-roll energy

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あ、それと机の上の文庫本、片付けて。漫画みたいに見えると恥ずかしいから。
lines.en: Oh, and put away those paperback books on the desk. They look like manga and it's embarrassing.
lines.style: Suddenly remembering another worry, voice rising with fresh urgency

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文庫はちゃんとした小説だよ!お母さん、なんでそんなに緊張してるの?
lines.en: These paperbacks are actual novels! Mom, why are you so on edge about this?
lines.style: Indignant defense softening into curious teasing toward mother

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: だって先生がうちにいらっしゃるなんて初めてでしょ。あ、もうインターホン鳴った!
lines.en: Well, it's the first time the teacher has ever visited our home. Oh, the doorbell just rang!
lines.style: Flustered confession cut short by panicked startled realization

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はいはい、私が出るから。お母さんは深呼吸して、エプロン外しなよ。
lines.en: Okay okay, I'll get the door. You take a deep breath and take off your apron.
lines.style: Taking-charge teen calmly grounding the panicking parent
